title: House spatial separation and exposing-building-face distance (Council Order 0015471)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The appeal concerned a residence and application of Articles 9.10.15.5.(2) and 9.10.15.4.(1), including an exposing building face within 1.2 m of a property line.

The appellant described two likely 48-by-36-inch bedroom windows and two basement windows along the wall in question; the order reports distances of 1.09 m from siding and 1.15 m from foundation at the northwest corner.
The appellant said a survey pin was bent and cited a small measurement discrepancy; the appeal record included an as-built survey and two respondent exhibits.

limitations: The order’s underlying plans and complete survey exhibits are not separate attachments.
